transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Could you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess... the main thing is that I've just stopped caring about everything I used to look forward to. My fishing gear is still sitting untouched out in the garage. The woodshop just feels like a chore if I even go in there. And, well, even when my kids try to get me to play a game of chess with them, I'm really just going through the motions. I just don't have any interest in things anymore, and it's starting to become a real problem.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for the past two weeks or more?

I don't know if "down" is the right word for it. I mean, I'm not really sitting around feeling sad or crying or anything like that. It's more just... I just feel kind of blank most of the day. So I haven't really noticed feeling depressed in that way, just empty, I guess.
Have you noticed a lack of energy or feeling fatigued most of the time, even after getting enough rest?

Yeah, definitely. It doesn't really matter how much sleep I get, the energy just isn't there. By midmorning, I feel like I’ve already worked a full shift. I manage construction sites, and lately... well, just walking the project or climbing the stairs with the crew, it feels like my body is carrying wet concrete. I'm just completely drained most of the time.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight lately—like eating a lot less or more than usual, or losing or gaining weight without trying?

Yeah, I have. Most days, food just tastes like cardboard to me. I'll usually skip breakfast completely, and even if I've been out on a job site all day, I just sort of pick at my dinner. I haven't been trying to lose weight or anything, but I've definitely had to pull my belt in a couple of notches lately.
Have you found yourself feeling worthless or guilty about things more often lately?

Yeah, I have. I just... I keep thinking I’ve failed my wife and my kids. And the guys at work, too. It seems like if anything goes wrong lately—a cost overrun on a job, a safety issue, or even just a missed appointment—I just take it as proof that I’m completely useless. Honestly, I've been feeling like everyone would just be better off without me in charge.
Have you had episodes like this before, where you've felt this way for a long period of time?

No, I haven't. I mean... I've had stressful stretches at work before, sure, like when a project gets behind schedule or something. But nothing like this. I've never felt this low or completely drained for this long. This is really the first time it's been anything like this.
Have you ever had a period in the past where you felt down or lost interest in things for a long time, similar to how you're feeling now?
No, like I was just saying... I've never had anything like this happen before. I've never felt this down or just... stopped caring about things for this long. This is definitely the first time.
Have you ever experienced a time before this where you felt this level of disinterest or emotional emptiness for a similar length of time?

No, really, I haven't. I know you're trying to be thorough, but... I've never felt like this before. This emptiness, or whatever you want to call it... it's completely new to me. I've never gone through a period like this in my entire life until now.
How long have you been feeling this way — this lack of interest, emptiness, and fatigue — has it been going on for at least two weeks now?

It's been a lot longer than two weeks. It's... well, it's been going on for about a year and seven months now. That's when my wife’s health problems started, and it just kind of changed everything at home.
Have you noticed any trouble focusing or making decisions lately—like when you're trying to read, plan something out, or figure out what to do next at work or at home?

Yeah, it's... it's been really bad actually. I used to be able to keep all the schedules and all the subcontractors straight in my head without even trying. But lately... I don't know, I'll read the same email three times and still not really get what it says. I even forget what I was about to say in meetings. And making decisions... things I used to figure out in five minutes, I just freeze up now. I can't seem to think straight.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety, unable to sit still lately?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I don't feel like I'm moving slow, and... I'm not really restless either. Just tired. But as far as moving or talking differently, no, I don't think so.
Have you had any thoughts about hurting yourself or ending your life?

Yeah, I have. Um... mostly when I'm driving to the site in the morning. It's early, nobody else is really on the road yet, and... I just catch myself thinking that it would be a whole lot easier if I just didn't make it there. Sometimes the thought of just pulling the wheel and steering off the road pops into my head. It actually scares me a little bit, because... well, because it feels a little too close to actually doing it.
Have you ever experienced a major depressive episode like this before in your life, or is this the first time you've felt this way?

No, this is... this is the first time. I've never dealt with anything like this before. I mean, I've been stressed out with work over the years, but I've always been able to just push through it and get the job done. This is completely different. I've never felt this way in my life.
